objective: Desktop Cluster/Organization Connect must start compact in center with explicit Expand/Collapse, while left Main navigation works immediately from any Cluster tab without requiring Back or bypassing scope membership.
productionBaselineEvidence: Authenticated GitHub Main source at 3ead9e9a2ce707b10fa9c53aa17d39f3b1e5ebaf verified. User 2026-11-07 desktop screenshots show huge center Cluster Connect and side nav seeming unusable; this is visual evidence, not live runtime deploy SHA verification.
chosenApproach: Constrain only wide-desktop scoped Connect to 340px/740px card and expand the existing single shared chat component within routed center on explicit user click. Replace immediate scope-reset navigation with active-PUBLIC-confirmed pending destination, bound to account and latest click, retaining guard and errors.
selectionRationale: Existing Connect uses full flex height; global sidebar races with canonical managed-scope guard, causing navigation rebound. Fix one presentation and one state transition without rewriting messages or altering security scope resolution.
alternativeApproaches: Create second chat/RPC or iframe: rejected, duplicate state and permission risks.
Make all scope Connect permanently full screen: rejected, user wants compact first.
Bypass canonical scoped permission guard to make sidebar clickable: rejected, security regression.
Rely on Back then tap a sidebar button: rejected, unnecessary navigation.
